findings.claim: The railroad-review section of docs/workflows.md still documents the lane, refuter, station and cleanup branches as claude/railroad-{direction}-l{i}-r{round}-{hash6}, claude/railroad-refute-..., claude/railroad-station-... and claude/railroad-*, while this change moved railroad-review.js (L80-82, L129, L367, L535-537) and the SKILL.md (ROUND-002/007/009/021) to the claude-review/* namespace. The repo convention (docs/workflows.md 'Document each new workflow with a section in this file') makes this section the workflow's reference; a developer locating a round's leftover branches from it searches the retired namespace.
findings.fix: In docs/workflows.md L65 replace claude/railroad-{direction}-l{i}-r{round}-{hash6} with claude-review/{direction}[-{chunk}]-l{i}-r{round}-{hash6}, claude/railroad-refute-... with claude-review/refute-..., claude/railroad-station-... with claude-review/station-..., and the cleanup's claude/railroad-* with claude-review/*.
findings.evidence: Re-read docs/workflows.md at 1f725ce (git grep: L65 holds all four claude/railroad-* strings) and railroad-review.js at 1f725ce (laneBranchName L80-82 claude-review/${d}-..., refuter branch L367 claude-review/refute-..., station L129/L535-537 claude-review/station-...); the diff updated the script and SKILL.md but left docs/workflows.md L65 untouched.
